title: Polish Mushroom Wrap
description: A delicious and gluten-free Polish-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms in a crunchy warm wrap.
instructions: 1. Slice the Polish sausage into thin pieces.
2. In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
3. Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned.
4. Add the sliced onions and cook until softened.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
6. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender.
7. Warm the gluten-free wrap according to package instructions.
8. Assemble the wrap by adding the cooked sausage and mushroom mixture.
9. Top with crunchy slaw and serve.
